## Post 2

**bamspeedy.224** — New User; registered April 2013; United States; posted November 18, 2018; solution post.

I failed to defend Derby but I just reloaded. I have been meaning to let the fail stay to see what happens later, now I know this sounds like 'missing missions' that isn't really talked about in walkthroughs.

You need to pick a different mission when 'Defend __' is down to 0!

Now, sometimes there is no other choice, but here's some tips:

Play the missions to earn blazons, those use up turns, to help get the turns down. (Defend Lincoln doesn't have any of these).

Just before hitting the check mark at the end of completing a mission, save the game. When completing a mission is when the game chooses the new missions for you. So after completing a mission if you don't get any other options, reload to end that mission again and try again. Sometimes, though no matter how often I reload I am not given any alternatives, as obviously most story missions can't be skipped and don't have a 'fail' option.

## Post 3

**bamspeedy1** — New User; registered January 2019; United States; posted January 12, 2019.

I played again, purposely trying to do ambush missions instead of the story missions to delay them/lose them if possible. Didn't get all the way to the end yet, but I can say this:

Trying to fail defending Lincoln, the countdown reset after completing "Wedding and a Funeral", but nonetheless still able to do it.

If you fail 'Defend Lincoln' this results in the new mission "Free Lincoln" (after Defend Leicester, another simple defend mission where you just acquire blazons. Can't seem to fail this one, and that makes sense as you wouldn't have any castles left to launch allied attacks from if you lose it.)

After you free Lincoln, you'll have to defend it again. So you could repeat these missions multiple times.

If you fail 'Defend Derby' you'll have to repeat 'The Black Castle'.
